h1: Secure APIs and backends that power your product
overview: We build the part of your product that users never see but everything depends on: the API, the database and the background jobs. We design the data model with you, build endpoints in Node.js or Python, protect them with authentication, and write documentation your front end team can use straight away. It is tested, deployed to your own hosting, and monitored with basic error logging.

faq: Which languages and databases do you use?
Node.js with TypeScript or Python, with PostgreSQL by default and MongoDB where it fits. If you have a stack in mind, tell us and we say whether we can match it.
We apply standard protections: authentication, input checks, limited permissions and encrypted connections. A full security review by a specialist is separate. We note what we did and did not cover.
Can you build the front end to match?
Yes, with our web app service. This service gives you the API and documentation, which any front end team or mobile developer can use.
Can the API handle high traffic?
We build on solid, scalable foundations and keep queries efficient. We do not promise traffic numbers, and we flag limits we expect in your handover notes.
